messages:
Asha: Observed weird spikes in the canary today: a bunch of requests were routed off the canary due to 'entitlement check failed'. Console just shows a generic 403. We should surface a Permission Timeline per route so PMs can see who lost access when and why.
Theo: Do we mean a timeline that overlays role/grant changes, authz denials, and quota blocks against the rollout window? That seems useful.
Riley: Minimal event fields we'd need: timestamp, actor, effective_principal, role, outcome (allowed|denied|quota_blocked), reason, and a linkable audit_id.
Ned: From infra side: authz-service writes audit logs but they're too chatty and not structured for the Console. I propose emitting a compact "authz_eval" event to the event-stream with a canonical id the router can reference on fallback.
Asha: UX note: Console should let us "overlay canary window" so we can correlate grant changes with canary % ramps. Also highlight sudden spikes in denied_rate.
Theo: Main constraint is volume. We shouldn't emit every evaluation for high-throughput routes. Suggest sampling by route+minute with counters and one exemplar event per sample.
Riley: And emit prometheus-style counters with labels: reason=(quota|denied|ok), role=..., route=... so Grafana can alert on rising denied_rate without needing full event stream.
Asha: API debate: should the exemplar include policy_version and role_source (direct vs inherited)? I think yes, helps root-cause during rollouts.
Ned: That means policy-service must return policy_version in the grant decision API. Small change but doable.
deploy-bot: canary: route r-ignite bumped from 15% -> 50% :rocket:
Asha: Proposed plan: (1) Ned + Theo spec event shape + sampling rules, (2) Riley add counters + dashboard panels, (3) Asha produce Console mock with timeline + exemplar link. Target: before next canary ramp. Any objections?
Theo: I'll sketch a schema. Example exemplar payload:
```json
{
  "event_type":"authz_eval_v2",
  "id":"evt_2025_0001",
  "route":"r-ignite",
  "ts":"2025-11-05T09:12:03Z",
  "actor":"svc:ingest",
  "principal":"team:acme",
  "role":"canary_writer",
  "outcome":"quota_blocked",
  "quota_id":"q_canary_tps",
  "policy_version":"pv_42",
  "sampled":"true"
}
```
Riley: For dashboards I'll add: (a) denied_rate heatmap by route/role, (b) exemplar link in the panel, (c) timeseries with canary-overlay option.
Ned: I'll wire policy_version into the authz response and emit canonical ids. Low risk change.
Asha: Sounds good. I'll draft the Console mock and a short spec for the Permission Timeline microcopy.
Theo: I'll open the schema PR and the sampling config.
Riley: Dashboard PR incoming, will reference sampling tags.
Asha: Great, sync next Tuesday to verify end-to-end smoke. Thanks. :thumbsup:
